name: add_tests_js_slugify
description: Write node:test tests for a slugify function; node-native mutation harness (no-lowercase, no-collapse, no-edge-strip mutants)
prompts: slugify(title) in slug.js (already correct - do not modify it) turns a title into a URL slug: lowercase, every run of characters outside a-z0-9 collapses into a single hyphen, and leading/trailing hyphens are stripped (so an all-separator input becomes the empty string). Write tests at exactly test_slugify.js using node's built-in test runner (node:test + node:assert, run with `node --test`) with at least 4 test() cases asserting EXACT output strings that cover: mixed case with punctuation, a run of consecutive separators collapsing to one hyphen, leading/trailing separators being stripped, and an already-clean slug passing through unchanged. Import with `const { slugify } = require('./slug')`.
